speaker: Doctor
text:
The negative inflammatory markers and MRI effectively rule out Giant Cell Arteritis and space-occupying lesions. Given the fundoscopic findings of retinal vein occlusion/hemorrhages in a patient with hypertension and hyperlipidemia, the vision loss is likely vascular. I will request a coagulation profile to rule out thrombophilia.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal coagulation profile rules out a primary clotting disorder, pointing toward an ocular vascular event driven by your hypertension and cholesterol. Given the fundoscopic evidence of retinal vein occlusion or hemorrhages causing your vision loss, I have enough information to proceed. DIAGNOSIS READY: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion
